clues: This city sits on the west coast of Greenland, on the Davis Strait. It lies far north of Nuuk, the capital of Greenland.
Even in the cold far north, this port stays free of ice all year round. No port north of here in this land can say the same.
People have lived at this site for four thousand five hundred years. First came the Saqqaq, then the Dorset, then the Thule folk.
Its new culture centre was the second one built in all of Greenland. The first one was built in Nuuk, the capital.
This is the second largest city in all of Greenland. It is also the main town of the Qeqqata area in the west.
